# Delay_Aware_Autograd_Spiking_Framework

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spike-based autograd-compatible framework that explicitly models and backpropagates through synaptic and axonal delays. Enables accurate training of spiking neural networks with temporal dynamics, critical for real-time event-driven processing.
